eyebrow.zh: 数学 · 证明 · 可验证

headline.zh:
模型说「已证明」
谁来检查？

sub.zh: 数学编程 agent 生成代码的同时附上 Lean 证明证书——证明不过就把类型错误喂回去迭代修复，直到类型检查通过。
sub.en: A math-coding agent that emits code with a Lean proof certificate — if the proof fails, the type error goes back for repair until it passes.

title.zh: Lean 当编译器，不是模型当裁判
title.en: Lean as the judge, not the model

body.zh: 证明过不过由 Lean 类型检查器的退出码决定，不由模型自评。你可以随时自己 lean out.lean 复查，2 秒。
body.en: Proof passed or not is decided by the Lean type-checker exit code, not by the model. Re-check with lean out.lean yourself — 2 seconds.

title.zh: 起草→检查→修复，自动迭代

body.zh: agent 同时起草 Python 实现 + Lean 4 证明，证明不过就把 Lean stderr 喂回模型重新起草，循环到通过或达上限。
body.en: The agent drafts Python code + a Lean 4 proof in one call. If the proof fails, the Lean stderr goes back to the model for a re-draft — loop until pass or cap.

title.zh: 附机器可检查的证书，不是散文

body.zh: 每次生成附带 certificate.json，proof_passed 字段由 lean 退出码决定。不信任模型，信任编译器。
body.en: Every run emits certificate.json with a proof_passed field set by the lean exit code. Don't trust the model — trust the compiler.

body.zh: 一条命令跑完整循环，无需 API key、无需装 Lean。要跑真实证明，装一次 Lean 4 + 任意 OpenAI 兼容 key 即可。
body.en: One command runs the full loop — no API key, no Lean install. For real proofs, install Lean 4 once + any OpenAI-compatible key.

headline.zh: 别再信任似是而非的数学

sub.zh: 一条命令，让 Lean 编译器替你检查证明。
sub.en: One command — let the Lean compiler check the proof for you.

tag.zh: MIT 开源 · Lean 当编译器
tag.en: MIT open source · Lean as the compiler
